extracted.intended_audience: Senior/key personnel and other significant contributors preparing an NIH grant biographical sketch (NIH applicants)
extracted.subtask_description: Prepare a NIH-format Biographical Sketch for senior/key personnel and significant contributors, following NIH-mandated sections, fields, and page limits. Includes personal statement, positions and honors, selected peer-reviewed publications, and research support.

rubrics_metrics.name: Overall format and page limit
rubrics_metrics.description: Provide the following information for the Senior/key personnel and other significant contributors in the order listed on Form Page 2. Follow this format for each person. DO NOT EXCEED FOUR PAGES.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Biographical Sketch may not exceed four pages. Follow the specified format and order for each person listed on Form Page 2.

rubrics_metrics.name: Name field
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Provide the person's full name in the NAME field (sample: 'Hunt, Morgan Casey').

rubrics_metrics.name: Position title
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Provide the current position title (sample: 'Associate Professor of Psychology').

rubrics_metrics.name: eRA Commons user name
rubrics_metrics.description: eRA COMMONS USER NAME (credential, e.g., agency login)
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Provide the applicant's eRA Commons user name/credential (sample: 'huntmc').

rubrics_metrics.name: Education/Training
rubrics_metrics.description: EDUCATION/TRAINING (Begin with baccalaureate or other initial professional education, such as nursing, include postdoctoral training and residency training if applicable.)
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Include for each entry: INSTITUTION AND LOCATION; DEGREE (if applicable); MM/YY; FIELD OF STUDY. Begin with baccalaureate or other initial professional education and include postdoctoral and residency training if applicable.

rubrics_metrics.name: Personal Statement
rubrics_metrics.description: A. Personal Statement — Briefly describe why your experience and qualifications make you particularly well-suited for your role (e.g., PD/PI, mentor, participating faculty) in the project that is the subject of the application.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Within this section you may, if you choose, briefly describe factors such as family care responsibilities, illness, disability, and active duty military service that may have affected your scientific advancement or productivity. Focus on relevance of experience/qualifications to the proposed project.

rubrics_metrics.name: Positions and Honors
rubrics_metrics.description: B. Positions and Honors — List in chronological order previous positions, concluding with the present position. List any honors. Include present membership on any Federal Government public advisory committee.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Provide positions and employment chronologically (ending with current position). Include other experience and professional memberships and list honors with dates where applicable.

rubrics_metrics.name: Selected Peer-reviewed Publications (limit and exclusions)
rubrics_metrics.description: C. Selected Peer-reviewed Publications — NIH encourages applicants to limit the list of selected peer-reviewed publications or manuscripts in press to no more than 15. Do not include manuscripts submitted or in preparation.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Select publications based on recency, importance to the field, and/or relevance to the proposed research. Do not list manuscripts that are only submitted or in preparation.

rubrics_metrics.name: Public Access Policy citation requirements
rubrics_metrics.description: When citing articles that fall under the Public Access Policy, were authored or co-authored by the applicant and arose from NIH support, provide the NIH Manuscript Submission reference number (e.g., NIHMS97531) or the PubMed Central (PMC) reference number (e.g., PMCID234567) for each article.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: If the PMCID is not yet available because the Journal submits articles directly to PMC on behalf of their authors, indicate 'PMC Journal - In Process.' A list of these Journals is posted at the provided URL. Citations not covered by the Public Access Policy but publicly available may include URLs or PMCID numbers along with the full reference. Copies of publications are not accepted as appendix material.

rubrics_metrics.name: Research Support (scope and content)
rubrics_metrics.description: D. Research Support — List both selected ongoing and completed research projects for the past three years (Federal or non-Federally-supported). Begin with the projects that are most relevant to the research proposed in the application.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Briefly indicate the overall goals of the projects and responsibilities of the key person identified on the Biographical Sketch. Do not include number of person months or direct costs. Include both ongoing and completed support; order by relevance to proposed research.

rubrics_metrics.name: Order and completeness requirement
rubrics_metrics.description: Provide the following information for the Senior/key personnel and other significant contributors in the order listed on Form Page 2.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Ensure every person listed on Form Page 2 has a Biographical Sketch following this same format and order; do not omit required sections.
